company.name: Taskade
company.shortDescription: Taskade is a real-time organization and collaboration tool for distributed teams.
company.description:
Taskade is the unified workspace for distributed teams. Automate your workflows, chat with your team, and get work done, in one simple and elegant tool. 

Taskade is cross-platform and syncs in real-time on all devices — Web, iOS, Android, Chrome, Firefox, Mac and PC.  

Collaborate Live
Edit projects in real-time. Chat and video conference on the same page.

Toggle Views
Select the perfect view for your project. From Task List to Kanban Board to Mind Map. 

Team Calendar
Keep track of tasks across multiple teams and workspaces.

Team Roadmap
Plan, manage, and visualize projects.

Follow us at https://blog.taskade.com
Visit us at https://taskade.com
